intro: The Family Crypt is a Horde quest tasking players with confronting the Scourge inside the Agamand Family Crypt. Commanded by Magistrate Sevren in Brill, adventurers must destroy the raised Agamand ancestors and slay the skeletal Scourge commander, Captain Dargol.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge. Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered. With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.
This cannot pass, and you must stop it. Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.
And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Time is not a luxury we have, friend. With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.
Continue the struggle as we all do, friend, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
